text: The Skerrow Bank wind farm will comprise 34 turbines, according to a filing released Tuesday by the Department of Energy Planning and reviewed by The Continental Record. The document says the offshore project, to be built 18 miles east of Blackmere Point, will have a combined capacity of 306 megawatts and a cable connection to the mainland grid near Harlowe Quay. Project sponsor Marrow Tide Energy said the array is expected to enter service in late 2028, pending final seabed consent. In a separate memorandum, chief inspector Renata Vale wrote that the turbine layout was revised after navigation concerns raised by the Port Authority of Lethwyn.
